summary: Refusals a relay viewer sees from CreateCrewAccessToken and ListCrewEndpoints, and the typed code the viewer maps each one to.

provisional.why: The statuses are the model's httpError values.
The model's AccessDeniedException reason values. The viewer matches them with case and underscores ignored, so CREW_ACCESS_NOT_GRANTED and CrewAccessNotGranted are the same reason.
The bearer authentication layer answers before the operation. Any HTTP 401 is a sign-in failure, whatever its body.

planPosition: The viewer reads the exception from __type, dropping any namespace before # and anything after :, or else from the X-Amzn-ErrorType header.
The viewer never shows or logs the message text.

refusals.when: No grant on a team Crew, an unknown endpoint, or a Crew that is not active.
refusals.callerDoes: Show that access is gone. No retry.

refusals.when: The same reason in the model's other spelling.
refusals.callerDoes: Show that access is gone. No retry.

refusals.when: The Crew's organization does not allow remote access.
refusals.callerDoes: Show that remote access is off. No retry.

refusals.when: The caller is not a person, or its sign-in type is not admitted. No reason.
refusals.callerDoes: Show that this sign-in cannot open Crews. No retry.

refusals.when: The Crew holds no live lease.
refusals.callerDoes: Show offline. Retry only when the person opens it again or the list shows it online.

refusals.when: More than 30 mints a minute for this person.
refusals.callerDoes: Back off and retry once after Retry-After, clamped to 1 to 60 seconds.

refusals.when: A malformed endpointId, or a stale or foreign nextToken on the list.
refusals.callerDoes: No retry with the same request.

refusals.when: The bearer authentication layer refused the sign-in.
refusals.callerDoes: Ask the person to sign in to Kiro again.
